name: BECU
notes: Researched from public becu.org pages only (no sign-in). The bill is a BECU loan or credit card payment. In Online Banking: Payments > BECU Payments > Pay BECU Accounts opens Make a Payment on a BECU Account, with a Pay menu offering Set up / Manage autopay. Online Autopay only draws from a personal external account (business accounts not allowed); autopay from a BECU account needs the Manage Autopay from a BECU Account form (term loans) or the Visa Automatic Payment form (cards, up to 10 business days). Recurring payments from a BECU deposit account are scheduled in Online Banking. Autopay changes are allowed only up to 3 business days before the due date; one-time external loan payments can be cancelled up to 3 business days before the payment date; card payments cannot be changed or cancelled online. Credit cards can autopay the Minimum Payment Due or the Last Statement Balance (described in help; the loan mock's autopay form offers regular/fixed). External payments in the mobile app are not available (Online Banking only). Sign-in is User ID + password with one-time passcodes by text or email; forgot User ID/password needs User ID or identity details plus a passcode. eStatements: 18 months online, kept 7 years; enrolled under Account Services > Enroll for eStatements. HELOC/line-of-credit payments must come from a BECU account. No public no-login payment page found. Pending SAFE Credit Union merger is not modelled.

pay_online.note: Online Banking pays from a BECU account or an external account; the mobile app pays from BECU accounts only.

autopay.note: Online Autopay draws from a personal external account. Autopay from a BECU account is set up with a form.

autopay_cancel.note: Use Pay > Manage > Turn Off Autopay, up to 3 business days before the due date.

pay_by_phone.note: Phone payments come from a BECU deposit account.

help.title: Ways to pay a BECU loan or credit card
paragraphs: Online Banking lets you pay from a BECU checking or savings account or from an external account. The BECU Mobile App pays from BECU accounts only; external-account payments are Online Banking only. HELOC and line-of-credit payments must come from a BECU account.
You can also pay in person from a BECU deposit account at any location, by phone at 800-233-2328 from a BECU deposit account, or by mailing a check to BECU's Seattle payment post office box.

Payments from a BECU account to a loan made before 7 p.m. Pacific post the same day; card payments must be made by noon Pacific. External one-time payments post effective the scheduled date, but the money can take up to four business days to leave the other account.
steps: Log in to Online Banking and choose Payments.
Under BECU Payments, click Pay BECU Accounts.
Pick the loan or card and the account to pay from.
Enter the amount and date and confirm.

help.title: Set up, edit or turn off Autopay
paragraphs: On Make a Payment on a BECU Account, open the Pay menu and click Set up. Choose the Pay From account (personal external accounts only), pick a Payment Type for a credit card (Minimum Payment Due or Last Statement Balance), continue, accept the Acknowledgement and Consent and click Schedule Autopay.

To change it, open Pay > Manage to see Autopay Details. To stop it, click Turn Off Autopay and confirm. Autopay can be changed only while no payment is in process, up to 3 business days before the due date.
Autopay from a BECU account uses a form instead: Manage Autopay from a BECU Account for term loans, or the Visa Automatic Payment form for credit cards (allow up to 10 business days).
steps: Choose Pay From, continue, accept the consent and click Schedule Autopay.

help.title: Cancelling a scheduled payment
paragraphs: A one-time payment to a loan from an external account can be cancelled if it has not been processed, up to 3 business days before the payment date. Payments to credit cards cannot be modified or cancelled in Online Banking.

help.title: eStatements
paragraphs: In Online Banking open the Account Services tab and select Enroll for eStatements. For a consumer credit card, scroll to the credit card section of Account Services and choose Enroll for Visa eStatements. BECU emails you when a new eStatement is ready.
Consumer statement history stays in Online Banking for 18 months, and BECU keeps all statements, including eStatements, for seven years.

help.title: Security verification codes
paragraphs: BECU may send a one-time code by text or email for sensitive actions such as logging in to Online Banking or changing your password. Enter it before it expires.
BECU will never contact you to ask for a code. If someone does, hang up and call 800-233-2328.

help.title: Enroll in Online Banking
paragraphs: Have your savings account number (for example your Member Share Savings number, shown on your monthly statement) ready, then use Enroll Now on the website or Enroll in Online Banking in the app. Forgot your password? Choose Forgot your password on the desktop sign-in page or Reset your password in the app.

extra.intent: Using BECU's help pages, find how many months of consumer statement history are kept in Online Banking. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: 18 months of statement history are kept online.

extra.intent: Using BECU's help pages, find how many business days before the due date is the last chance to change Autopay on a BECU loan. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Up to 3 business days before the due date.
